critical_code_review_comments: downline_live_feed.py:181 — get_earnings_summary uses `to_list(length=100000)`. For extremely active networks this could blow up. Consider a MongoDB $group aggregation (single round-trip, DB-side sum) instead of Python fold. Not blocking for current scale.

downline_live_feed.py:71 `since` is passed as an ISO string in the query. Since timestamps in prc_ledger are ALSO stored as ISO strings, string comparison works because ISO-8601 UTC strings are lexicographically sortable — but this is fragile if any writer starts emitting +05:30 offset strings. Consider migrating timestamps to native BSON Date or documenting the invariant.

downline_live_feed.py:53 `_ensure_auth()` returns an async wrapper but is never wired into the router — GET /referrals/live-feed/{uid} has NO auth dependency (docstring even says 'IDOR protection is added by requiring the token subject to match uid, enforced upstream via the existing user auth chain', but that upstream chain is not visible in this router file). This means anyone who knows a UID can fetch that user's referral earnings and downline names/timestamps. Recommend wiring Depends(_get_user_from_token) and validating token.sub == uid before returning. HIGH-priority privacy fix.

DownlineLiveFeed.js:64 timeAgo prints '3600s ago' up to 59s but the '?s ago' unit rolls to minutes at 60. Consider hiding sub-minute noise for the first-view (e.g. '<1m' for anything under a minute) to reduce visual jitter with the 30s polling.

ReferralsEnhanced.js:38 openLiveFeed calls navigate immediately after rewardedAd.open — good for AdMob compliance, but the modal (rewardedAd.element) is mounted on the ReferralsEnhanced page, so once we navigate away the modal is unmounted. If the intent is to keep the ad prompt visible on top of Live Feed, the RewardedInterstitial provider needs to be lifted higher (App-level). If the intent is 'fire-and-forget prompt only shows if the user hasn't left yet', current impl is fine — just document it.

rca of the issue: IST bucketing bug (pre-fix): boundaries were computed at UTC 00:00 → rows timestamped IST 00:00-05:29 (= UTC 18:30-23:59 previous day) fell into UTC 'yesterday' and were incorrectly reported to Indian users as 'yesterday'. Fix applied in downline_live_feed.py:162-176 correctly computes boundaries in IST first (today_start_ist etc.), then converts to UTC for the Mongo string-comparison query. Both boundary cases now pass: (a) IST 00:15 today = UTC 18:45 yesterday → correctly bucketed 'today', (b) IST 23:45 yesterday = UTC 18:15 two-days-ago → correctly bucketed 'yesterday'.
